name: Japan Pure Chemical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Japan Pure Chemical Co., Ltd. is a Japanese maker of plating chemicals based on precious metals, supplied to the electronic components industry at home and abroad. Its products include electrolytic gold plating for semiconductors, printed wiring boards, connectors and contacts, strike and flash gold plating for lead frames, and palladium formulations, along with stripping agents and chemicals for surface treatment. Dating from 1971, it has its base in Tokyo, Japan.
